Dr. Ginger Henson

Dr. Ginger Henson, M.D. is a board certified oculofacial plastic surgeon serving the Cincinnati/Dayton area. Born and raised in Cincinnati, Dr. Henson is a graduate of Miami University and earned her medical degree from the University of Cincinnati College of Medicine. She then completed her Ophthalmology residency at the prestigious Bascom Palmer Eye Institute in Miami, Florida. During her residency, Dr. Henson developed a deep appreciation for the artistry of oculofacial plastic surgery. She returned to Cincinnati to master the nuances of oculofacial plastic surgery during her fellowship in Ophthalmic Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery at the Cincinnati Eye Institute. Throughout her career, she has served in many capacities including Director of Pediatric Oculoplastic Surgery at Cincinnati Children’s Hospital Medical Center and Director of Oculoplastic Surgery at the University of Cincinnati. In addition, she served on the Board of Directors at the Cincinnati Eye Institute for many years.

After practicing for over 15 years, Dr. Henson co-founded her own private practice along with her colleague, Dr. Jonathan Pargament. Their vision for AestheticEye Oculoplastic Surgeons is to deliver outstanding surgical results with an exceptional patient experience in a supportive, relaxed environment. She continues to teach and mentor resident surgeons and medical students as a volunteer Professor of Ophthalmology at the University of Cincinnati.

Dr. Henson was awarded a Top Doctor award from Castle Connolly. The Castle Connolly recognition in medicine is considered by physicians to be the only legitimate recognized category of excellence in American Medicine.

Dr. Henson is skilled in cosmetic upper and lower eyelid surgery, brow surgery, and MOHS reconstructive surgery. She also has a passion for non-surgical facial rejuvenation techniques including neurotoxins, CO2 laser resurfacing and IPL.In her free time, she enjoys traveling with her husband and keeping up with their five children and spoiled goldendoodle, Paxton.

Dr. Jonathan Pargament

Jonathan Pargament, M.D. is an experienced oculofacial plastic surgeon in the Cincinnati/Dayton area and co-founder of AestheticEye Oculoplastic Surgeons. Born and raised in Toledo, he holds an honors degree from the University of Michigan and earned his medical degree from the University of Cincinnati. He completed his ophthalmology residency at the University of Cincinnati before completing in a rigorous three-year oculofacial plastic and reconstructive surgery fellowship at the Center for Facial Appearances in Salt Lake City. Dr. Pargament then spent the next 8 years after fellowship growing a successful oculoplastic practice in the Cincinnati/Dayton area as partner in a large multi-speciality ophthalmology group in the region.

In 2025, Dr. Pargament and Dr. Henson decided to start their own practice, AestheticEye Oculoplastic Surgeons, to continue serving the needs of their patients in the Dayton and Cincinnati area. Dr. Pargament’s particular interests include endoscopic and minimally invasive brow lifts, upper and lower lid rejuvenation procedures and reconstructive surgeries after skin cancer removal (Mohs). He is a board-certified member of the American Academy of Ophthalmology and American Society of Oculoplastic and Reconstructive Surgeons. He is an adjunct professor of plastic surgery and ophthalmology and director of oculoplastic and reconstructive surgery at the University of Cincinnati. Dr. Pargament has delivered numerous presentations at regional and national meetings and authored many book chapters and peer-reviewed journal articles.

Today, Dr. Pargament co-leads AestheticEye Oculoplastic Surgeons, mentors aspiring surgeons and dedicates his expertise to the underserved at the University of Cincinnati Hoxworth Eye Clinic. Outside of work, Dr. Pargament stays busy with his three young children and rescue lab, Sadie, that he shares with his wife and neuro-ophthalmologist, Dr. Laura Hanson. He loves the outdoors, especially fly-fishing, and international travel.

Sarah Morris

Sarah Morris, APRN, FNP-C is a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner with specialized expertise in oculoplastic care. Originally from Flemingsburg, Kentucky, Sarah earned her Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science from the University of Kentucky before pursuing her Bachelor of Science in Nursing at Bellarmine University in Louisville, Kentucky.

Following completion of her nursing degree, Sarah practiced in the Cardiovascular Intensive Care Unit at University of Kentucky Hospital, where she developed a strong clinical foundation caring for complex medical and surgical patients. She later earned her Family Nurse Practitioner degree from the University of South Florida in Tampa, graduating with honors and earning induction into the Sigma Theta Tau International Honor Society of Nursing. She is an active member of the American Association of Nurse Practitioners.

At AestheticEye, Sarah works closely with Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jon Pargament to provide comprehensive perioperative and non-surgical care. She manages post-operative patients, performs in-office procedures such as biopsies of suspicious lesions and chalazion treatments when clinically indicated, and offers aesthetic services including neurotoxin treatments with Dysport® and Botox® as well as UltraClear® laser treatments.

Outside of the office, Sarah enjoys staying active, spending time outdoors, and attending sporting events—especially cheering on the Kentucky Wildcats. She also values time traveling and making memories with her husband, Nat, and their two daughters.

Renee Ingle

With more than 30 years of experience in advanced skincare, Renee is a trusted and familiar face in the field of aesthetic care. Her approach combines deep clinical knowledge with a warm, patient-centered touch—making every treatment both effective and comfortable.

At AestheticEye, Renee provides a full range of customized skincare services, including HydraFacial®, chemical peels, microneedling, and dermaplaning, as well as personalized treatment plans tailored to each patient’s skin goals. She believes that beautiful skin begins with a healthy foundation and focuses on treatments that restore balance, radiance, and confidence.

Renee’s passion for skincare is matched only by her dedication to patient relationships. She takes pride in creating a welcoming experience where patients feel understood, supported, and genuinely cared for. Her decades of experience allow her to deliver consistent, natural-looking results that align perfectly with AestheticEye’s commitment to excellence and patient-centered care.

Kelcie Graber

Director of Operations

Kelcie’s path to practice administration isn’t a typical one. She started her career as a Registered Veterinary Technician in emergency medicine, where she developed a calm-under-pressure approach and a sharp eye for detail that still defines her work today.
After discovering a passion for oculoplastics, she joined Dr. Henson’s team in 2016. She earned her ophthalmic certification, grew into an ophthalmology surgical technician role and eventually took on leadership of two practice locations, building the kind of hands-on clinical foundation that most administrators simply don’t have.

Today, Kelcie oversees compliance at AestheticEye, bringing the same methodical care to operations that she once brought to the surgical suite

Tyler Byers

Patient Experience & Aesthetic Services Supervisor

Tyler brings a genuine commitment to warmth and human connection to his role at AestheticEye, where he oversees the patient experience, marketing efforts and patient-facing communication. With a background in fine dining operations, he spent years mastering the art of hospitality creating environments where people feel truly cared for, understood, and at ease. He brings that same philosophy to AestheticEye every day, pairing his passion for skincare and non-surgical aesthetics with a service-forward approach that ensures patient touchpoints are polished, consistent and welcoming.

Raven May

Surgery Scheduler, Dr. Pargament

Raven brings more than seven years of experience working alongside Dr. Pargament to her role as Surgery Scheduler, having previously served as his Clinical Team Lead. Her deep familiarity with his surgical techniques, patient care philosophy, and procedural processes gives her a level of insight that translates directly into exceptional patient support. Known for her warm demeanor and meticulous attention to detail, Raven ensures that every patient feels informed, confident, and well-prepared from scheduling through surgery day.

Siera Barrett

Clinic Manager

Siera has been a cornerstone of Dr. Henson’s team for more than seven years, bringing a deep clinical foundation built through hands-on experience in surgical preparation, patient care, and practice operations. Her thorough knowledge of Dr. Henson’s procedures and protocols — combined with her calm, compassionate presence — creates an environment where patients feel genuinely supported at every stage of their care. Siera’s kind and thoughtful approach to each interaction reflects her unwavering commitment to patient comfort and confidence.

Madison Allen

Clinical Lead, Dr. Pargament

Madison has been an integral part of Dr. Pargament’s team for more than five years, developing a comprehensive understanding of his clinical approach, surgical processes, and the coordination required to guide patients seamlessly through each stage of their care. In addition to her clinical leadership role, she oversees referral scheduling — ensuring every incoming patient is connected to the right care quickly and efficiently. Known for her reliability and steady presence, Madison’s organizational strengths and patient-focused approach keep operations running smoothly and every patient experience well in hand.

Kim Triado-Soto

Medical Technician

A proud Dayton native, Kim spent three years in comprehensive ophthalmology care with a focus on cataract surgery before following a long-held dream into the world of oculoplastics. She found her home at AestheticEye, where she’s been able to grow her clinical expertise while doing work she truly loves. As a medical assistant, Kim brings a genuine warmth to every patient interaction. She has a deep passion for medical-grade skincare and laser services — the kind of enthusiasm that’s contagious and that patients notice right away.

Marivic Colliflower

Lead Medical Technician

Marivic Colliflower has been a cornerstone of our team since the beginning, bringing with her a wealth of experience from her time at the Cincinnati Eye Institute. As our Lead Medical Technician, she combines clinical precision with a warmth that patients feel. Her attention to detail ensures that every step of a patient’s experience is handled with care, while her gentle, reassuring presence has a way of putting even the most anxious patients at ease. Marivic is more than a skilled technician she’s the steady heart of our clinical team and we’re proud to have her leading the way.
